terminal_record.title: Unverified Claim That Robert Maxwell Aided Mogilevich's Passport and Banking Network
terminal_record.description_short: Unverified TrumpFile allegation that Robert Maxwell helped Mogilevich obtain passports and banking access.
terminal_record.description_medium: TrumpFile’s timeline alleges that Robert Maxwell arranged Israeli passports for Semion Mogilevich and 23 associates in 1988, opened a Bank of New York account used for laundering, and connected Mogilevich with KGB chief Vladimir Kryuchkov. An FBI report dated August 1996 instead names Shabtai Kalmanovich in connection with passport access. Neither source independently establishes Maxwell’s alleged role or a relationship to Donald Trump.
terminal_record.description_long: TrumpFile labels this account “Robert Maxwell obtains passports for Mogilevich, helps KGB” and dates its timeline item July 1, 1988. The page’s narrative says the alleged passport arrangement happened “sometime in 1988,” and alleges that Maxwell obtained Israeli passports for Semion Mogilevich and 23 associates, set up a Bank of New York account for money laundering, and introduced Mogilevich to KGB chief Vladimir Kryuchkov. These are claims made by TrumpFile, not independently verified findings. A separately accessed text extraction of an FBI report dated August 1996 says Israeli passports had been obtained by Shabtai Kalmanovich for members of organized-crime groups including the Mogilevich organization. That report does not establish Maxwell’s alleged role, the Bank of New York account, or the KGB connection; its reference to Kalmanovich also cautions against treating TrumpFile’s attribution as confirmed. No passport, bank, court, or contemporaneous record confirming Maxwell’s role is supplied. The packet also provides no link between this 1988 allegation and Donald Trump. This internal draft preserves what the supplied timeline alleges while leaving its date at year-level precision and marking the event unverified; the exact day, related outcomes, and asserted Trump relevance remain unresolved.
